function.name: find_beer
function.description: Recommend a beer based on specified attributes such as name, brewery, taste, aroma, color, style, and more. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

beer_name.description: The name of the beer to search for.

brewery.description: The brewery name to find similar beers.

taste.description: The desired taste profile in the beer, such as 'bitter', 'sweet', 'sour'.

aroma.description: The desired aroma profile in the beer, such as 'fruity', 'hoppy', 'malty'.

color.description: The desired color of the beer, such as 'pale', 'amber', 'dark'.

style.description: The style of beer being searched for, such as 'IPA', 'stout', 'lager'.

abv_min.description: The minimum alcohol by volume (ABV) percentage, typically a value under 12.5%. This is a float type value.

abv_max.description: The maximum alcohol by volume (ABV) percentage, a value logically above 0%. This is a float type value.

ibu_min.description: The minimum International Bitterness Units (IBU) score, typically a value under 120.

ibu_max.description: The maximum International Bitterness Units (IBU) score, logically above 0.

pairings.description: A list of food items to pair with the beer, such as 'burger', 'cheese', 'chocolate'.

message.content:
A great way to finish off a plate of Korean fried chicken is a dessert that’s both sweet enough to satisfy your palate and light enough not to overwhelm the flavors you’ve just enjoyed. Here are a few options that work nicely:

| Dessert | Why it works | Pairing notes |
|---------|--------------|---------------|
| **Shaved Ice (Bingsu)** | The cold, fluffy texture and subtle sweetness cut through the richness of the fried chicken. | Top with fresh fruit, condensed milk, or a drizzle of honey‑soy sauce for an extra flavor twist. |
| **Chocolate Lava Cake** | The warm, gooey center offers a comforting contrast to the crispy, spicy chicken. | Serve with a scoop of vanilla ice cream or a splash of coffee liqueur for depth. |
| **Mango Sticky Rice** | The tropical mango and coconut milk add a sweet, creamy finish that balances the savory and spicy notes. | A sprinkle of toasted sesame seeds adds a subtle nuttiness that echoes the roasted flavors of the chicken. |
| **Korean Hotteok (Sweet Syrup Pancake)** | The syrupy filling inside a soft pancake provides a sweet, caramelized finish. | The slight crunch from the pancake edges mirrors the crispness of the chicken. |

If you’re looking for something quick and easy, a simple bowl of shaved ice topped with fresh berries or a drizzle of honey will do the trick. If you want a richer finish, a chocolate lava cake or a classic Korean dessert like hotteok will complement the meal beautifully. Enjoy!
